findings.detail: Structural: EN source begins with Markdown heading '## Chapter 11', accepted RU begins bare 'Глава 11'; restore heading '## Глава 11' for proper EPUB structure.
Source has one 'Chapter End Notes' heading, translated file has two consecutive headings 'Примечания автора к главе' and 'Примечания в конце главы'; remove duplicate without touching bt-anchor.

Arian's 'I have wanted you for longer than I care to admit' rendered as 'Я хочу тебя гораздо дольше, чем готов признать' has unidiomatic present-tense duration; use 'Я давно тебя хочу — гораздо дольше, чем готов признать' preserving admission.
Author's 'poor attempt at writing smut' softened to 'попытка написать откровенную сцену'; preserve intentionally self-deprecating explicit register without embellishment.
